row.notes: Creates the child vector header at parent+0x10 when missing, allocates a 0x18-byte node, appends it to that vector, reads the name (key hash 0xfe07306) into node+0, then resolves the member table (key hash 0x871f67c3) with Vm_PkgObj_ResolveRootOffset and walks its keyed entries (count = low 24 bits of +4, stride 8 or 0xc, offset at +0xc). For every member it reads the type string (key hash 0xd34355db) and dispatches to itself, 0x1442af830 or 0x1442b02e0 with the new node as parent; returns 0 or an error code (3 = key missing) that is also written to the TLS error slot and trace ring. Context from caller: Vm_Load_UidfDataSources 0x1442ae430 runs the same type dispatch at the top level; its KB note gives the three type strings as Dictionary, Array, Variable, so this is the Dictionary case.
